card.name: Digit zero inside ID numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside longer numeric codes such as ISBN, ISSN, phone numbers and ZIP codes. It fires on a zero that sits within the number, not at its start or end.

modes.label: ISBN/ISSN digits
modes.description: A zero within a book or journal serial number.

modes.label: Phone and ZIP digits
modes.description: A zero within a phone number or postal code.

card.plain: It notices a zero buried in the middle of a reference number like an ISBN or phone number.
